title: Find First and Last Position of Element in Sorted Array
statement: `nums` is sorted non-decreasing. Return the start and end index of `target`. If it is absent, return [-1, -1].
hints: Two binary searches: one for the lower bound and one for the upper bound.
Lower bound is the first index with nums[i] >= target. It is a hit only if the value equals target.
Upper bound is the first index with nums[i] > target. The last occurrence is that index minus one.

approaches.name: Linear scan
approaches.explanation: Find the first and keep the last.

editorial: Implement lower_bound(x) as the first index whose value is at least x, using a half-open interval. The start is lower_bound(target) if it lands on target. The end is lower_bound(target + 1) - 1. If the start is out of range or the value differs, return [-1, -1].
